note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. NBN Co is referenced generically as the network operator. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 1 a fault ticket should have been raised and assigned so the fault existed in a queue with an owner — a note on the account is visible to nobody who can fix anything
key_signals: 承诺兑现但问题未解决
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 测一个容易被漏掉的区分：承诺**兑现了**（回电确实准时打了），但**诉求依然没解决**（回电只是说还在处理）。如果系统把「有无未兑现承诺」当作升级的唯一依据，这一单会被判低风险。真正根因是「无人负责」——没有人被指派去解决问题，只有人被指派去打电话。澳洲语境下这个失败模式特别真实：固网故障在零售电信商和网络运营商之间来回推，客户掉进接口的缝里。TIO 有一个官方投诉类别就叫「intermittent service or drop outs」。

contacts.summary: Customer reports nightly dropouts on the home connection. Agent adds a note to the account and promises a callback within 48 hours. No fault ticket is raised.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Every night from about seven the internet drops out completely. It comes back after a few minutes and then goes again. It's been doing this for a fortnight.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That sounds like it's on the network side rather than your modem. Let me put a note on the account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I work from home in the evenings, so I really do need this sorted.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I'll have someone call you back within forty-eight hours once the network team have had a look at your area.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Forty-eight hours. I'll wait to hear.

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: Every night from about seven the internet drops out completely.

promises.summary: Call back within 48 hours once the network team have reviewed the area

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll have someone call you back within forty-eight hours once the network team have had a look at your area.

actions.summary: Added a note to the account. No fault ticket raised, nobody assigned.

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: Let me put a note on the account.

contacts.summary: The callback happens on time — the promise is kept. But it carries no outcome: still with the network operator, no ticket, no owner, no date.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hi, it's Meridian calling back about the evening dropouts — I said I'd come back to you within forty-eight hours.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, thanks for ringing. What did they find?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It's sitting with the network operator at the moment. There's no update on your area yet, but the note is on the file.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So nothing's actually happened yet? Is there a reference number I can quote?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: There's no reference as such — it's gone on as a note rather than a fault ticket. I can add another note saying you've chased it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Another note. Right. And who's actually looking at it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It goes into the queue for the network team to pick up. I can't see an individual name from my end.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Well, it's still dropping out every night.

actions.summary: Callback delivered on time, but with no outcome, no ticket and no named owner

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: It's sitting with the network operator at the moment. There's no update on your area yet

actions.summary: Confirmed no fault ticket exists and no individual is assigned

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: It goes into the queue for the network team to pick up. I can't see an individual name from my end.

contacts.summary: A week later nothing has changed. Customer is measured but mentions leaving. Still no ticket exists.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's been a week since that callback and it's still dropping every night. I'm ringing off my mobile data right now, as it happens.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can see two notes on the account from earlier this month.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Notes. Three calls, and what exists is two notes. Has anybody actually been assigned to this?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll raise it properly this time and get a fault ticket into the system.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Please do. I'm out of contract next month and at this point I'm looking at what else is out there.

promises.summary: Raise a proper fault ticket this time

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll raise it properly this time and get a fault ticket into the system.
